mobilny.brak_kodu_na_zdjeciu: No QR code found in the photo. Take it closer, with the whole label in the frame.

mobilny.brak_polaczenia: No connection with the program. Check that it's running and the phone is on the same Wi-Fi.
mobilny.instrukcja_android: Android: download the certificate, then Settings → Security → Encryption & credentials → Install a certificate → CA certificate.
mobilny.instrukcja_iphone: iPhone: open the certificate link below in Safari, allow the download, then Settings → “Profile Downloaded” → Install, and Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings → turn on NORNICA / VOLE. Reopen this page.
mobilny.kamera_brak: No suitable camera was found. Use “Take a photo”.
mobilny.kamera_niedostepna: The camera is not available. Use “Take a photo”.
mobilny.kamera_odmowa: Camera access was denied. Allow it in the browser settings or use “Take a photo”.
mobilny.kamera_wymaga_certyfikatu: The live camera needs a trusted connection — see the setup steps below. Until then, scan with “Take a photo”.
mobilny.kamera_zajeta: The camera is in use by another app or browser tab. Close the camera app or other scanner tabs and try again — or use “Take a photo”.
mobilny.tyl_zajety: The rear camera is in use by something else, so the front one started. Close apps that use the camera (on Android a green dot in the top corner shows the camera is in use) or restart the phone, then try again.

mobilny.zly_klucz: This pairing code is no longer valid. Scan the code shown in the program again.

The model “{model}” belongs to a different category. Changing the category here would detach the model and its specs.

Move the model (with its {liczba} item(s)) to “{kategoria}” instead? You'll see what happens to the specs first.
pytanie.usun_lokalizacje_z_zawartoscia: Location “{nazwa}” is not empty ({lista}). Delete it and move its contents to “{cel}”?
pytanie.usun_pole_dane: It has values in models: {modele}, items: {egzemplarze}. They will be deleted together with the field.

“{tytul}” is no longer linked anywhere. Delete it together with its file?

Choose No to keep it in the library.

pytanie.usun_zdjecie:

slowniki.kategoria_wbudowana: Built-in category: it can't be renamed or deleted, but you can add your own fields and subcategories to it.
slowniki.lista_wbudowana: Built-in list: its values stay, but you can add your own with “List values…”.
slowniki.pole_tylko_odczyt: Built-in fields and fields inherited from a parent category can't be changed here — inherited fields are edited in their own category.
slowniki.rodzaj_podpowiedz: Used only for a main category — a subcategory takes the kind of its parent.
slowniki.typ_tekst_lista: Changing “Text” to “Choice from a list” keeps your data: values already entered are added to the list.
slowniki.wartosci: Values to choose from — one per line
slowniki.wartosci_podpowiedz: A value used by a model or item can't be removed.
slowniki.wstep: Add your own categories, spec fields and statuses. Built-in entries are kept up to date by the program, so they are read-only — but you can add your own fields to any category, built-in ones too. Subcategories inherit the fields of their parent.
slowniki.wybierz_kategorie: Choose a category on the left to see its spec fields.
telefon.adres_podpowiedz: If the phone can't connect, try another address — the computer may have several network cards (VPN, virtual machines).
telefon.bez_szyfrowania: The cryptography library is missing, so the connection is not encrypted: the phone can scan from photos, but not with the live camera. Install: pip install cryptography (Arch: pacman -S python-cryptography).
telefon.iphone_kroki:
1. On the iPhone open in Safari: {adres} and allow the profile download.
2. Settings → “Profile Downloaded” (top of the list) → Install.
3. Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings → turn on “NORNICA / VOLE”.
4. Scan the code above with the iPhone camera.
Without these steps the page still works, scanning from photos.
telefon.iphone_tytul: Live camera on iPhone — one-time setup
telefon.kroki: Point your phone camera at the code on the left and open the link. Then scan labels with the page — the computer shows each item right away.
telefon.wstep: Your phone can scan the QR labels over your home Wi-Fi — no app to install. The program starts a small server; the phone opens a page in its browser. Phone and computer must be on the same network.
telefon.zapora_brak: No firewall found (ufw, firewalld) — nothing to open. Check that the phone is on the same Wi-Fi network as the computer.
telefon.zapora_firewalld:
The firewalld firewall is installed and may block the port. Open it:
sudo firewall-cmd --add-port={port}/tcp
telefon.zapora_mac: macOS may ask about incoming connections when the server starts — allow them (port {port}).
telefon.zapora_ufw:
The ufw firewall is installed and may block the port. Open it:
sudo ufw allow {port}/tcp
telefon.zapora_windows: When the server starts for the first time, Windows asks about network access — allow it for private networks (port {port}).
trw.instrukcja: Paste the address of a product page, e.g. https://theretroweb.com/motherboards/s/zida-4dps, and click “Download”. A preview will appear here — nothing changes until you click “Apply”.
trw.licencja_info: Only text data is copied (no photos or files). The Retro Web content is under CC BY-SA 4.0 — the source link and licence are kept in the model description.
trw.nadpisz: Overwrite fields I have already filled in
trw.nieprzypisane: Connectors without a match in the program: {lista}
trw.wstep: Fill in the model from The Retro Web (PC hardware: motherboards, expansion cards, drives). Find the product page, paste its address and download — or save the page in the browser and load the file.
zasoby.brak_pillow: Previews need the Pillow library: pip install Pillow. Photos are stored anyway.
zasoby.podpowiedz: Click a photo to open it. Right-click for more options.
zlacza.brak: No connectors yet — add them below.
zlacza.brak_na_liscie: Not on the list? Add your own type.
zlacza.podpowiedz_wiersz: Select a row to change it. Right-click for options.
zlacza.typ_wbudowany: Built-in types can't be edited or deleted — only the ones you added.
